settings.label: Brand name
settings.info: Used in the header, mobile menu and footer. Independent of the Shopify store name.

settings.label: Founder name
settings.info: Named in Organization schema as the founder. A real name only — leave blank rather than inventing one.

settings.label: Default sharing image
settings.info: Used as og:image on pages with no image of their own — the homepage most of all. 1200x630 or wider works best.

settings.content: Used when a section has no override

settings.label: Featured collection
settings.info: Primary shopping destination for brand-level CTAs.

settings.label: Featured product
settings.info: Used by the sticky buy bar on non-product pages. Optional.

settings.content: Used in footer and support links

settings.label: Support email
settings.info: The branded support address. Also used as the Organization schema email.

settings.content: One line above the Add to Cart on product pages. Keep each entry to two or three words: three fit on one line at 375px, and a fourth is hidden on small phones. Leave any of them blank to drop it.

settings.label: Dispatch promise
settings.info: Shown first in the trust line, e.g. "Ships within 24 hours". Deliberately blank by default: only fill this in if it is true of every order, every day. It is a delivery promise a customer can hold you to, not a marketing line.

settings.label: Show the announcement bar on product pages (mobile)
settings.info: Off by default. On a phone the announcement bar repeats the trust line above the Add to Cart, and the masthead is sticky, so it holds 32px out of the viewport for the whole visit. Switch it on if the bar carries something else — a sale, a shipping cut-off, a festival message.

settings.content: Set in Shopify admin, not theme code
Payments, COD and tracking are configured in Settings.

settings.label: Prepaid discount percent
settings.info: Must match the value of the discount code above. The buy box multiplies the price by this to show the shopper what they actually save in rupees.
